_comment: Base entry of the fire weapon tree. A stick wound with lichen dipped in larval residue that keeps a flame. Dual-purpose: illuminates the darker reaches of the descent (Limbo, the castle's interior corridors) AND functions as a light bludgeon. Refinements of the tree land later (firebrand, cauterizer, class-specific end-tiers). Held in either hand like any weapon. Damage is low; the value is the light.
name: Torch
description: A stick wound with pale lichen and dipped in larval residue. The flame will not go out.
